subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining work stop at documenting current TUI multiline behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a public TUI send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: The base Shift+Enter newline behavior is dependency-backed, but configurable Enter/Ctrl/Cmd/Shift behavior would create a new public TUI preference or config surface.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Add TUI docs and /help shortcut text for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback without adding configuration.

options.title: Add TUI Preference
options.body: Expose a narrow TUI-local keybinding preference with default Enter-to-send compatibility and focused tests after maintainers choose the owner surface.

options.title: Broaden Composer Policy
options.body: Unify TUI and WebChat send-shortcut semantics across product surfaces, accepting a larger settings and docs project.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Add TUI docs and /help shortcut text for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback without adding configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest observed combination of prior issue review and TUI/editor ownership history for choosing the product boundary.
